risk_if_not_implemented: Without Access Profile Rules, unauthorized individuals, devices or services may gain access to Technology Assets, Applications, Services, Data and/or Facilities (TAASDF). Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Excessive or Unauthorized Privilege (R-AC-2), Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to enforce Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) to restrict access to individuals assigned specific roles with legitimate business needs.
compensating_control_1.justification: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) (IAC-06) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Access Profile Rules (IAC-07.2) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC)
compensating_control_2.description:
Automated mechanisms exist to enforce Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) through policy-driven, dynamic authorizations to:
(1) Enforce usage conditions for users and/or role; and
(2) Support the secure sharing of information.
compensating_control_2.justification: Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) (IAC-07) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Access Profile Rules (IAC-07.2) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
